verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk or batch operation capability for acting on many items at once. The Plugin API's read/write access is only a developer building block from which bulk tooling could be built. The variables endpoints and MCP canvas writes describe per-item create/modify actions and do not mention batch semantics. The community mention of a third-party bulk export plugin is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: allowing developers to view, create, and modify the contents of files
